'''Reni Coll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] freedom fighter and leader of the [[Freedom Advocacy Movement]]. In [[44 ABY]], she took part in negotiations with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] that addressed the previous slave revolts on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. She was also a political rivalry with [[Padnel Ovin]], who took advantage of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and made plans against him. Since an agreement between the resistance fighters and the Alliance was reached, Coll greeted the [[Raharra Lapti]] during a Jedi delegation on Klatooine.
